current_validation_limits: Positive FEM determinants and static-bone path admission are separate from rendered-skin validity.

Local nonincident crossings and 1e-6-trimmed incident crossings have no new hits in tested two moving skin states; shared strips remain excluded.
No full skull, mandible, dentition, jaw, eyelid, neck, bilateral pose, surrounding solved facial tissue, physiological tendon, or calibrated activation model.
